quests.title: First Steps
quests.lore: Every Hunter starts with an axe and a sore back. Bring the Guild some timber.

quests.title: Tools of the Trade
quests.lore: Stone before steel. Craft yourself a proper pickaxe.

quests.title: Night Watch
quests.lore: The dead walk when the sun sleeps. Put ten of them back in the ground.

quests.title: Bone Collector
quests.lore: Skeleton archers have been picking off travellers. Thin their ranks.

quests.title: Eight Legs
quests.lore: Spiders nest close to the roads. Clear them out.

quests.title: Into the Stone
quests.lore: Light keeps the monsters away. Mine coal for the Guild's torches.

quests.title: Iron Will
quests.lore: Brann needs ore for his forge. Find iron.

quests.title: Harvest
quests.lore: A Hunter that doesn't eat doesn't hunt. Bring wheat for the Guild kitchen.

quests.title: Shield Bearer
quests.lore: Learn to block before you learn to strike. Craft a shield.

quests.title: Rank E Trial: Creeper Hunt
quests.lore: Your first trial. Creepers have levelled three farms this week. End them, quietly.

quests.title: Drowned Depths
quests.lore: Something drags fishermen under at night. Hunt the drowned.

quests.title: The Smith's Request
quests.lore: Brann Ironfist is out of iron, again. Help him out.

quests.title: Stock the Larder
quests.lore: Hunters return hungry. Fill the Guild's larder.

quests.title: Desert Dust
quests.lore: Husks stalk the dunes and never tire. Bring them rest.

quests.title: Cold Bones
quests.lore: Strays freeze their victims with every arrow. Silence them.

quests.title: Copper Veins
quests.lore: Copper for the Guild's lightning rods. Dig deep.

quests.title: Woodcutter
quests.lore: The Guild Hall needs a new wing. Bring a mountain of timber.

quests.title: Bowyer
quests.lore: New recruits need bows. Craft three.

quests.title: Slime Trouble
quests.lore: Slimes keep bouncing out of the swamps. Squash them.

quests.title: E-Rank Exam: The Bone March
quests.lore: Prove you are ready for D-Rank. Twenty-five skeletons, no excuses.

quests.title: Golden Hour
quests.lore: Gold glitters for kings and Hunters alike. Find some.

quests.title: Witch Hunt
quests.lore: Witches brew poison in the marshes. Break their cauldrons.

quests.title: Phantoms of the Night
quests.lore: Those who never sleep are hunted from above. Strike them from the sky.

quests.title: Silk and Steel
quests.lore: The Guild's fletchers need string. Lots of it.

quests.title: The Archer's Mark
quests.lore: Skeleton camps are growing. Show them a real archer.

quests.title: Lapis Lore
quests.lore: The Archmage needs lapis for her enchantments.

quests.title: Enchanter's Table
quests.lore: Steel is strong. Enchanted steel is stronger. Craft an enchanting table.

quests.title: Redstone Pulse
quests.lore: Redstone runs the Guild's gates. Bring the dust.

quests.title: Raider Scouts
quests.lore: Pillager scouts were seen near the outposts. Strike first.

quests.title: D-Rank Trial: The Raid Captains
quests.lore: Vindicators lead the raids. Cut off the head and the body falls.

quests.title: Leatherworker
quests.lore: Armour starts with leather. Bring hides to the tanner.

quests.title: Endless Night
quests.lore: Endermen steal from the Guild's walls. Don't look them in the eye.

quests.title: Pearl Diver
quests.lore: The Archmage studies ender pearls. Bring her eight.

quests.title: Sea Legs
quests.lore: The drowned have taken a whole bay. Take it back.

quests.title: Blacksmith's Steel
quests.lore: Brann wants to see if you can forge your own armour.

quests.title: Bog Walkers
quests.lore: Poison-arrow skeletons stalk the swamps and trial halls. Hunt the bogged.

quests.title: Emerald Trade
quests.lore: Silas pays well for emeralds. Very well.

quests.title: Cave Crawlers
quests.lore: Venomous spiders nest in the old mineshafts. Burn them out.

quests.title: Smelter
quests.lore: The crown wants gold for its treasury.

quests.title: D-Rank Exam: Trial of Winds
quests.lore: The Breezes guard the trial chambers. Defeat six to earn C-Rank.

quests.title: Diamond Fever
quests.lore: Real Hunters carry diamond. Find your first.

quests.title: Mob Slayer
quests.lore: A horde gathers in the east. Fifty zombies, Hunter.

quests.title: Silverfish Infestation
quests.lore: Silverfish chew through the stronghold walls. Exterminate them.

quests.title: Obsidian Forge
quests.lore: The Guild is building a vault. Bring obsidian.

quests.title: Arsenal
quests.lore: Forge a diamond blade worthy of a C-Rank Hunter.

quests.title: Ocean's Guardians
quests.lore: Guardians lash out at every passing ship. Break their monument's defence.

quests.title: Undead Legion
quests.lore: A skeleton legion marches at night. Break it.

quests.title: Night Terrors
quests.lore: The phantoms grow bolder every night. Ground them.

quests.title: Amethyst Song
quests.lore: Amethyst hums with old magic. Harvest the geodes.

quests.title: C-Rank Trial: The Evokers
quests.lore: Evokers summon fangs from the earth. Defeat two and claim their totems.

quests.title: Glow Ink
quests.lore: The scribes need glowing ink for the quest board.

quests.title: Builder's Stone
quests.lore: The Hunter Association is expanding. Bring stone bricks for the walls.

quests.title: The Ravager
quests.lore: Ravagers flatten villages. Stop two of the beasts.

quests.title: Emerald Mine
quests.lore: Emeralds hide in the mountains. Find them.

quests.title: Masterwork Crossbows
quests.lore: The Royal Guard needs crossbows. Craft three.

quests.title: Creeper Purge
quests.lore: The creepers are breeding in the caves. Purge them.

quests.title: Witch Coven
quests.lore: A whole coven has gathered in the swamp. Break it.

quests.title: Golden Feast
quests.lore: The King is hosting a feast. Golden carrots, and plenty of them.

quests.title: Diamond Hoard
quests.lore: The crown's treasury demands diamonds.

quests.title: C-Rank Exam: The Monument Warden
quests.lore: An Elder Guardian curses the sea. Slay it to earn B-Rank.

quests.title: Jungle Jaws
quests.lore: Man-eating plants lurk in the jungle. Uproot five Foliaaths.

quests.title: The Diamond Eater
quests.lore: A Grottol is eating the deep diamond veins. Catch it before it digs away.

quests.title: Lantern Light
quests.lore: Floating lanterns lure Hunters into the dark forest. Pop them.

quests.title: Naga of the Coast
quests.lore: Sea serpents spit acid at ships near the cliffs. Bring them down.

quests.title: Iron Wall
quests.lore: A mansion's guards raid the roads. Twenty vindicators.

quests.title: Netherite Dream
quests.lore: Trade a fortune in diamonds for something rarer.

quests.title: Sky Breaker
quests.lore: The trial chambers are restless. Twenty Breezes.

quests.title: Trial Master
quests.lore: Prove you have conquered the trial chambers. Bring five trial keys.

quests.title: The Iron Colossus
quests.lore: A living suit of armour guards an ancient vault. Topple the Wroughtnaut.

quests.title: B-Rank Trial: The Frost Tyrant
quests.lore: The Frostmaw rules the frozen peaks. Shatter it.

quests.title: Monster Hunter
quests.lore: One hundred zombies. A real Hunter doesn't count, but the Guild does.

quests.title: Bone Throne
quests.lore: Build the Guild a throne of bones. One hundred skeletons.

quests.title: Arachnophobia
quests.lore: The spider queen's brood is endless. Seventy-five more.

quests.title: Endless Ender
quests.lore: Endermen gather in the dark plains. Thirty of them.

quests.title: Master Miner
quests.lore: Twenty-five diamond veins. The deep belongs to you now.

quests.title: Royal Armoury
quests.lore: Forge a diamond chestplate for the Royal Guard.

quests.title: Sea Monsters
quests.lore: Clear a whole ocean monument of its guardians.

quests.title: Pillage the Pillagers
quests.lore: Turn the raiders' own tactics against them. Fifty pillagers.

quests.title: Coven's End
quests.lore: End the witches' coven for good.

quests.title: B-Rank Exam: Tides of Ruin
quests.lore: Three monuments, three Elder Guardians. Earn your S-Rank.

quests.title: The Ancient City
quests.lore: Deep below lies a city of silence and a guardian that hunts by sound. Kill the Warden.

quests.title: Deep Dark Relics
quests.lore: The Archmage wants echo shards from the ancient cities.

quests.title: Hunter's Tithe
quests.lore: Every S-Rank pays tribute to the crown.

quests.title: Slayer Legion
quests.lore: One hundred creepers. Try not to lose your house.

quests.title: Raid Breaker
quests.lore: Ten ravagers. The villages will sing your name.

quests.title: Evoker's End
quests.lore: Hunt down ten evokers in their mansions.

quests.title: Crystal Heart
quests.lore: Two more Frostmaws have awoken in the north.

quests.title: Iron Graveyard
quests.lore: Every vault has its guardian. Topple three Wroughtnauts.

quests.title: Sky Lord
quests.lore: Master the winds. Fifty Breezes.

quests.title: S-Rank Trial: Shadow of the Throne
quests.lore: Two Wardens. Only the strongest Hunters walk out of the deep dark twice.

quests.title: Treasury of Kings
quests.lore: King Aldric is rebuilding the treasury. Thirty-two gold blocks.

quests.title: The Thousand Cuts
quests.lore: Two hundred and fifty zombies. Your blade should be tired by now.

quests.title: Bone Lord
quests.lore: Two hundred and fifty skeletons. Become the Bone Lord.

quests.title: Deep Diamond
quests.lore: Sixty-four diamond veins. The mountains have nothing left to hide.

quests.title: Guardian of the Deep
quests.lore: Six Elder Guardians. The seas are yours.

quests.title: Netherite Pact
quests.lore: Pledge four netherite ingots to the crown's war chest.

quests.title: The Ender's Gaze
quests.lore: One hundred endermen. Look them all in the eye.

quests.title: Legend of the Coast
quests.lore: Fifteen Naga. The coast will be safe for a generation.

quests.title: Tokens of Survival
quests.lore: Only a Hunter who has cheated death five times may face the final trial.

quests.title: OVERTHRONE
quests.lore: The final trial. Three Wardens. Do this, and the throne trembles at your name.
